meta.name: cloud-sync
meta.description: Set up or check claude-mem cloud sync with cmem.ai Pro. Use when the user says "set up cloud sync", "sync my memories", "cmem pro", "cloud backup", "sync status", or wants their memory database backed up or synced to their cmem.ai account.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将记忆数据备份同步到云端账户
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望将 Claude 记忆安全同步到云端
copy.tagline_en: Back up and sync memory data to your cloud account
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to securely sync your Claude memories to the cloud

howto.what: Claude 会帮你设置或检查 claude-mem 与 cmem.ai 账号的云同步:先查看当前同步状态,如需配置就向你要三个连接值并写入设置,重启后验证,最后报告设备号、待同步数等信息。它不会显示或记录同步令牌。
howto.when: 当你说出 “set up cloud sync”“sync my memories”“cloud backup” 等,或提出要把记忆数据库备份或同步到 cmem.ai 账号时,该技能会接管。

say.text: 帮我设置 cloud sync,连接我的 cmem.ai 账号
say.note: 会引导你提供令牌、用户ID和SyncHub网址
会报告设备ID、待同步数、上次同步时间等

say.text: 把我的记忆数据库同步到 cmem.ai
say.note: 会写入连接配置并重启验证

howto.what_en: Claude helps set up or check cloud sync between claude-mem and a cmem.ai account. It reads current sync status, writes three connection values into settings, restarts the worker, verifies, and reports device ID, pending counts, etc. It never prints or logs the sync token.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user says "set up cloud sync", "sync my memories", "cloud backup", etc., or asks to back up or sync their memory database to a cmem.ai account.

say_en.text: Set up cloud sync with my cmem.ai account.
say_en.note: Asks for token, user ID, and SyncHub URL.
Reports device ID, pending counts, last flush time, etc.

say_en.text: Sync my memory database to cmem.ai.
say_en.note: Writes connection config and restarts to verify.
